displayPattern: Status LED: 8 short flashes then 4 long flashes (Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump and 24VNA9 air conditioner; amber status LED on the outdoor control)
meaning: High pressure lockout for 4 hours, elevated from fault 31 when the stage (speed) can no longer be lowered.
causes: Low indoor airflow in heating mode
Reversing valve stuck in cooling (heating mode)
Loose or disconnected high pressure switch harness
Restricted filter drier or expansion device
diySteps: In heating mode, check the indoor coil and filter for restriction by debris and clean if necessary (the manual also says to troubleshoot the indoor fan motor)
Check the outdoor coil for clogging by ice or debris and clean or de-ice it if necessary (the manual also says to troubleshoot the outdoor fan motor)
Technician: make sure the service valves are open, check the pressure switch harness and connection, check the filter drier and expansion device, and check charge
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: lockout 84 involves refrigerant-side checks.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
